role.altitude: She still weighs, clears jams, watches the fill, and walks the line. Copies of grams and of fault lines she already wrote get shorter. She still stops the machine herself.
reach: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers can read a weight row she already wrote; they still grade and she still adjusts the fill.
First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers still hear the spoken report; a pasted fault line does not replace that conversation.
Food Batchmakers still set the batch; a copied problem line does not replace watching the glue.
Printing Press Operators still watch their own web; a tally of marks she wrote does not replace watching the fill.
skills_to_grow: Write the weight band before a compare runs
Write the fault in her own words before it is copied
Keep watching the fill and the glue, because a copied line is not a substitute for looking
role.ambitious_version: The grams and the fault line are on the sheet before she finishes the pack, and she still weighs, stops the machine, and watches the line.

tasks.short: Weigh, grade, and inspect packs, then adjust the fill.

steps.what: Write the weight specifications for this run
Weigh and inspect products, verifying the fill
Copy stored grams onto the weight row
Compare that row with her weight band
Grade products using the band result
Keep adjusting product weight and measurement

tasks.design: She writes the weight specifications in {DOCS} and weighs products herself, storing the grams as she inspects each fill. One step copies only those stored grams onto the weight row in {SPREADSHEET}, and a separate step compares that row with her weight band and writes inside or outside on the row. She still grades the products and keeps adjusting the weight; the compare does not stop the filler and does not page anyone.
tasks.previous_blocker: The grams lived on a paper slip beside the scale, and someone retyped them later against a band that was only a card at the filler.
tasks.enabler_now: A field copy can move grams she already wrote onto a row, and a second step can mark that row against the band she wrote. Both are ordinary record steps.
tasks.still_hard: She still weighs, looks at the fill, grades the pack and turns the filler. If the grams or the band are missing, the copy and the compare do not run.
tasks.human_edge: She feels a light pack, sees a bad seal and decides the grade. A mark on the row does not do that.
tasks.altitude: She still weighs, grades and adjusts the filler. The second typing of grams is gone. She gains no new decision right.

reach.role: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
reach.task: Grade finished packs against a weight band the operator already wrote.
reach.learn: Trust the row only when the grams and the band were written before the compare, and still grade the pack in person.

evidence.claim: A named statistical process control product reads gauges and compares those readings with stored limits.
Sorting good packs from bad packs by a weight band is not a safety function. Learning models are kept out of guards and stops, and this compare does not learn and does not stop the filler.

assumptions: She is the producer of the weight specifications in s1 (low, high, target) and of the scale grams in s2. Both captures stay at full length. The copy in s3 writes only grams she already stored. The compare in s4 only marks that row inside or outside her band. If either field is missing, that machine step does not run and she keeps the sheet herself.
Weighing, inspecting, grading and adjusting stay at full length. The compare writes on the row and does not page anyone and does not stop the filler. No operator name is stored.
Upkeep is zero hours per 100. The fields are the ones she still writes, and there is no extra tool to tend once the two record steps exist.
unknowns: Whether this filler already stores a gram value she can point at without writing it down.
Whether the weight band is issued on a card before the run or only remembered.
research_questions: What fraction of runs already have a written low, high and target before the first pack is weighed?

already_counted.description: Writing the band, weighing and inspecting, grading, and adjusting the filler, which stay at full length.

incremental.description: No extra upkeep: the band and the grams are steps she still does, and the copy and the compare run only when those fields exist.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low when the grams or the band were never stored and she keeps the sheet herself. High when both fields are already written and only the retype and the second look at the numbers disappear. She still weighs, inspects, grades and adjusts the filler.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Stop the machine, clear the jam, tell the supervisor.

steps.what: Stop and reset machines when malfunctions occur
Clear machine jams before the restart
Write the fault, the station and the time
Report malfunctions to the supervisor
Paste the stored fault onto the shift note

tasks.design: She stops and resets the machines, clears the jam, writes the fault with the station and the time in {DOCS}, and tells the supervisor herself. A paste step copies only that stored fault sentence onto the shift note in {DOCS}. The paste does not send the note, and she remains the one who stops the machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fault was a spoken aside, and the shift note was a second writing of the same sentence after the line was already running again.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she has written the fault, the station and the time, a paste can place that same sentence on the shift note. The paste is a copy, not a send.
tasks.still_hard: She still decides to stop, clears the jam by hand, and tells the supervisor. If she has not written the sentence, the paste does not run.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the jam, chooses the stop, and clears the product with her hands. A copied sentence does not do that.
tasks.altitude: She still stops the machine, clears the jam and speaks to the supervisor. Only the second writing of the fault line is gone.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers
reach.task: Hear the operator's spoken report of a malfunction.
reach.learn: Treat the shift note as a copy of a sentence she already wrote, and still take the spoken report.

evidence.claim: Learning models that ensure a safety function, including a stop, need a conformity assessment, so the stop stays with the operator. Consent rules cover systems that monitor staff presence, behaviour or performance, including per-operator logs; this note names the station and the fault only.

assumptions: She is the producer of the fault sentence in s3: fault, station and time, with no operator name. That writing stays at full length. The paste in s5 copies only that sentence onto the shift note. If the sentence is missing, the paste does not run. The paste does not send the note.
Stopping, resetting, clearing the jam and reporting to the supervisor stay at full length. No learning model is placed in the stop. She tells the supervisor herself; that talk is not a machine send.
Upkeep is zero hours per 100. The sentence is a step she still writes, and the paste adds no tool she must tend.
unknowns: Whether a works council at this plant would treat a station-and-fault note as monitoring of staff.
Whether the supervisor already expects a written line before the spoken report.
research_questions: What fraction of jams already have a fault, a station and a time written before the shift note is filled?

already_counted.description: Stopping and resetting, clearing the jam, writing the fault sentence, and telling the supervisor, which stay at full length.

incremental.description: No extra upkeep: the fault sentence is a step she still writes, and the paste runs only when that sentence exists.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low when she never writes the fault sentence and fills the shift note by hand. High when the sentence is already stored and only the second writing disappears. She still stops, clears and tells the supervisor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Watch filled packs and judge them against the standard.

steps.what: Write the conformity points in the standards
Observe machine operations on filled products
Record which standard the packaged product missed
Copy only her stored marks into the tally
Decide if filled products still meet standards

tasks.design: She writes the conformity points from the standards in {DOCS}, observes the filled products, and records which standard a packaged product missed. A copy step puts only those stored marks into the tally in {SPREADSHEET}. She still decides whether the filled products meet the standards.
tasks.previous_blocker: The mark was a tick on a card, and the tally was a second writing of the same tick at the end of the hour.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she has written which point a pack missed, a copy can place that mark on the tally. The copy adds no camera and no operator name.
tasks.still_hard: Watching the fill and deciding whether the pack meets the standard stay with her. If she wrote no mark, the copy does not run.
tasks.human_edge: She sees a skewed cap or a low fill and pulls the pack. A tally of marks she already wrote does not see the line.
tasks.altitude: She still watches the fill and decides whether the pack meets the standard. Only the second writing of the mark is gone.

reach.task: Watch a running web and note which point a copy missed.
reach.learn: A tally is only a copy of marks already written, and the watch of the web stays in person.

evidence.claim: Consent is required for systems that monitor staff presence, behaviour or performance, and per-operator logs and line cameras qualify. This tally stores neither an operator name nor a camera image.

assumptions: She is the producer of the conformity points in s1 and of the defect mark in s3. Both stay at full length. The copy in s4 writes only marks she already stored. If there is no mark, the copy does not run.

Observing the fill and deciding whether products meet the standards stay at full length. The tally has no operator name and no camera. She may pull a bad pack herself; that act is part of the watch, not a machine step.
Upkeep is zero hours per 100. The points and the marks are steps she still writes.
unknowns: Whether the plant already keeps a written list of conformity points for each pack format.
Whether pulling a bad pack is counted in her time or in a helper's time.
research_questions: What fraction of defect marks are already written in her own words before anyone fills the hourly tally?

already_counted.description: Writing the conformity points, watching the fill, recording the mark, and deciding whether the pack meets the standard, which stay at full length.

incremental.description: No extra upkeep: the points and the marks are steps she still writes, and the tally copy runs only when a mark exists.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low when she wrote no mark and fills the tally by hand. High when the mark is already stored and only the second writing disappears. She still watches the fill and decides.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Watch the line for pile-ups, jams, and loose glue.

steps.what: Monitor the production line for pile-ups
Keep watching for glue that is not sticking properly
Write the problems, the station and the time
Copy that stored problem onto the line log

tasks.design: She monitors the production line and keeps watching for glue that is not sticking, then writes the problems with the station and the time in {DOCS}. A copy step puts only that stored problem line onto the line log in {SPREADSHEET}. The copy does not page anyone, and she still walks the line.
tasks.previous_blocker: The problem was noticed on the walk, and the line log was a second writing of the same words at the end of the shift.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she has written the problem, the station and the time, a copy can place that line on the log. The copy is not a page and not a stop.
tasks.still_hard: Watching for pile-ups and for glue that is not sticking stays with her. If she wrote no problem line, the copy does not run.
tasks.human_edge: She sees a pile-up or glue that is not holding and deals with it on the line. A copied line does not see the glue.
tasks.altitude: She still walks the line and watches the glue. Only the second writing of the problem line is gone.

reach.task: Watch a line for a fault and write the station and the time.
reach.learn: The log is a copy of a problem line already written, and the walk of the line stays in person.

evidence.claim: Learning models are kept out of guards and stops, and this copy does not stop the line. Consent rules cover systems that monitor staff presence, behaviour or performance; the log names the station and the problem, not the operator.

assumptions: She is the producer of the problem line in s3: the problems, the station and the time, with no operator name. That writing stays at full length. The copy in s4 places only that stored line on the log. If the line is missing, the copy does not run. The copy does not page anyone and does not stop the line.
Monitoring the line and watching the glue stay at full length. No camera is added. No learning model is placed in a stop.
Upkeep is zero hours per 100. The problem line is a step she still writes.
unknowns: Whether pile-ups are already written anywhere before the end-of-shift log.
Whether a works council would treat a station-and-problem log as monitoring of staff.
research_questions: What fraction of line problems already have a station and a time written before the log is filled?

already_counted.description: Monitoring the line, watching the glue, and writing the problem line, which stay at full length.

incremental.description: No extra upkeep: the problem line is a step she still writes, and the log copy runs only when that line exists.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low when she wrote no problem line and fills the log by hand. High when the line is already stored and only the second writing disappears. She still walks the line and watches the glue.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
